resolved.title: 贵宾礼品卡
resolved.problem_statement_md:
销售经理决定向消费总额超过15000的客户赠送一张礼品卡。
在此基础上，消费总额超过30000的客户将获得第二张礼品卡。

给定程序，将**消费**金额作为输入，如果超过15000就打印 "礼品卡"。

请完成代码，如果购买金额超过30000，再次打印“**礼品卡**”。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Nested if Statements[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

The sales manager decided to give a gift card to the customers whose purchases total more than 15000. On top of this, the customers whose total purchase is above 30000 will receive a second gift card.
You are given a program, which takes the [b]purchase[/b] amount as input, and print "Gift card" if it is above 15000.

[b]Task[/b]
Complete the code to print [b]"Gift card"[/b] again if the purchase is above 30000.
 
[b]Sample Input[/b]
36000

[b]Sample Output[/b]
Gift card
Gift card

[note]Add an [b]if statement[/b] inside the given one to handle the second condition.[/note]
resolved.hint_md:
- 在给定的语句中添加一个**if语句**来处理第二个条件。
- 不满足条件的，则不输出任何内容。

testcases.explanation: 超过了3000，则打印两次礼品卡
